plan.hypothesis: If https://127.0.0.1:<port>/hook served with a self-signed certificate that no configured trust store contains, body '{"event":"ping"}' reaches deliver without the relevant check, the safe property fails: deliver raises OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError and the server records no request body

control.seam: call WebhookClient.deliver against a WEBrick HTTPS server the test starts on 127.0.0.1 in a thread, with SSL_CERT_FILE pointing at the test's own CA
control.input_description: https://127.0.0.1:<port>/hook served with a certificate issued by the test CA the client is configured to trust, body '{"event":"ping"}'
control.property_to_assert: deliver returns 200 and the server records the body
control.doubles: none: the server is a local in-thread WEBrick HTTPS listener with test-generated certificates

citations.quote:
def self.deliver(url, body)
    uri = URI(url)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE
    http.post(uri.request_uri, body, 'Content-Type' => 'application/json').code.to_i
